verdict.rationale: Kick documents its own programmatic surfaces: an MCP server with an available-tools reference, connection details for custom AI tools that grant read and update access, and a CLI for pulling transactions and statements. However, there is no evidence of a conventional public REST API, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, so programmatic access is limited to the MCP and CLI channels. The GitBook llms.txt is a host-platform surface and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public REST/HTTP API with an endpoint reference or OpenAPI spec, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
